add_style_of_type returns None instead of style object

#### Description

When calling `add_style_of_type()` on a styles object, the method returns `None` instead of the expected style object. This breaks code that expects to work with the returned style.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.style import WD_STYLE_TYPE

doc = Document()
styles = doc.styles

# This should return a style object but returns None
style = styles.add_style('MyStyle', WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH)
print(style)  # Prints: None
print(type(style))  # Prints: <class 'NoneType'>

# Expected behavior: style should be a style object
# Expected: <docx.styles.style._ParagraphStyle object at 0x...>
```

The method should return the created style object so it can be used for further configuration, but currently returns `None`.
</issue>
